title: echinochloa zonalis
intro: Echinochloa zonalis, commonly known as Bitter Millets, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including the ability to help manage diabetes and high blood pressure due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Bitter Millets include its use as a diuretic, expectorant, and demulcent, which can help to relieve symptoms of colds, coughs, and sore throats. The bioactive constituents of Echinochloa zonalis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
